html:
Hello, here is the nebula IC 1848 (Soul Nebula) photographed in the hydrogen alpha wavelength. IC 1848 is an emission nebula and an open cluster located 7500 light-years away in the constellation Cassiopeia.




Date:  2010/09/19 and 2010/09/21
Optical train = Takahashi Sky90 + f4.5 reducer - Astronomik Ha 13nm filter - Canon xsi unfiltered
Mount: Takahashi EM-200 Temma II driven with the SkyVoyager software via Skyfi
Site: At home
53 exposures of 5 min for 265 minutes
Dark, flat and bias applied
DeepSkyStacker + PhotoShop
Guided with Kwik Guider and the Phd software
